name: HR Database (PostgreSQL)
notes: Crown jewel. Stores NIK and personal data of all employees. Segregated VLAN. Direct internet exposure prohibited.

name: ERP Database (PostgreSQL)
notes: Core business data. Orders inventory finance. Backed up daily 02:00 WIB.

name: Edge Firewall (FortiGate 100F)
notes: Single internet uplink for Makassar branch. No redundancy. Remote changes require MFA jump-host.

name: Edge Firewall (FortiGate 600F)
notes: Main perimeter firewall for Jakarta HQ.

name: Core Switch (Cisco Catalyst 9500)
notes: Backbone for server farm and corp-jkt.

name: VPN Gateway
notes: Site-to-site VPN to Makassar branch. Remote access VPN for staff.

name: ERP Application Server
notes: Production ERP app. No direct internet access. Behind reverse proxy.

name: Backup Server (Veeam)
notes: Central backup repository. Daily incremental weekly full.

name: Warehouse Management System
notes: Makassar warehouse operations. Replicates to Jakarta nightly 23:00-02:00 WIB.

name: Monitoring Server (Zabbix)
notes: Infrastructure monitoring. Alerts to SOC team.

name: DNS Server (BIND9)
notes: Primary internal DNS. Secondary at backup-jkt-01.

name: Mail Server (Postfix)
notes: Internal mail relay. External mail via cloud provider.
